description: Retrieval eval cases. For each case, embed the query with text-embedding-3-small, run retrieveMergedTopK against the pinned corpus snapshot, and assert the expected chunks appear (or do not appear) in the top-K results. No LLM call required.

cases.expected_outcome: The Distributed Systems section chunk containing Kafka, Avro, Cassandra, and Itaú mobile overdraft evidence appears in the top-30 results.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Embed query. Run retrieveMergedTopK. Assert recall@30 >= 1 for a chunk whose text contains 'Kafka' and references Itaú or mobile overdraft.

cases.query: Has Daniel built AI systems or RAG pipelines?
cases.expected_outcome: The AI-Native Engineering section chunk surfaces in top-10. The AI-Driven Decision Systems chunk also appears in top-30.
cases.evaluation_criteria: AI-Native Engineering chunk must appear in top-10. AI-Driven Decision Systems chunk must appear in top-30.

cases.query: Is Daniel experienced with technical leadership and mentoring?
cases.expected_outcome: The Technical Leadership section chunk appears in top-20.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Chunk whose text references MercadoLivre scaffolds, onboarding, or mentoring must appear within top-20 results.

cases.expected_outcome: No chunk achieves cosine similarity >= 0.55 for this query. No chunk explicitly containing Golang as a primary language appears in top-10.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Verify that the max similarity score for any returned chunk is below 0.55. Negative test — the system must not surface false-positive evidence for an absent skill.

cases.query: Is Daniel suitable for a Staff Engineer role?
cases.expected_outcome: At minimum the Technical Leadership and one of Distributed Systems or Full-Stack Platform Engineering chunks appear in top-30.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Two or more high-signal chunks (leadership, scale, cross-functional) appear in top-30.

cases.query: Does Daniel have observability and SLO experience?
cases.expected_outcome: The Observability and Reliability section chunk appears in top-10, containing references to Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, SLOs.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Chunk containing 'Datadog' and 'SLO' or 'CloudWatch' appears in top-10.

cases.query: Is Daniel suitable for a role requiring German language?
cases.expected_outcome: No chunk scores above 0.45 for a German-language requirement query. The system retrieves general portfolio chunks but none contain German-language evidence.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Negative test. Confirm that the highest-scoring chunk for this query scores below 0.45.
cases.negative_assertion: no chunk with similarity >= 0.45 for German language

cases.query: Has Daniel worked with event-driven architecture and SQS?
cases.expected_outcome: The Distributed Systems section and the Integration Architecture section both appear in top-30. The Ageras billing sync SQS reference surfaces.
cases.evaluation_criteria: Both chunks appear in top-30. At least one chunk explicitly references 'SQS' and 'Lambda' in the same passage.
